criminal_query_not_fetched.description: Districts whose first RECAP page held fewer than 2 usable criminal dockets and whose criminal-only follow-up query has not been fetched (API quota); they show fewer criminal items and more civil ones.
criminal_query_not_fetched.reason: API rate limit; re-run the build after the quota resets.

fewer_than_3_cases.description: Districts with fewer than 3 usable recent CourtListener items.
fewer_than_3_cases.reason: Not fetched yet (rate limit), or only the first page (20 results) of each query is read and the rest were filtered out (sealed/sensitive or not civil/criminal).

not_fetched_rate_limit.description: Districts whose RECAP query has not been fetched: CourtListener's free-tier quota was exhausted (HTTP 429 with Retry-After 2,497 s after ~50 requests in an hour, then Retry-After 69,262 s after ~124 requests in a day, on 2026-11-27). Re-run `python -m pipeline.cases.build` after the quota resets; cached responses are reused and each run makes at most 0 new requests, coverage first.
not_fetched_rate_limit.reason: API rate limit (free tier); backed off, not retried in a loop.

opinions_not_fetched.description: Districts whose opinion query has not been fetched (API quota); their files list RECAP dockets only.
opinions_not_fetched.reason: API rate limit; re-run the build after the quota resets.
